On the PubMedQA dataset, we evaluated two Llama-3 8b models that were fine-tuned on the medical domain, one that was regularly trained and one with FF. We tested the models on a subset of 1K examples using few-shot in-context learning. The regularly trained model achieved an accuracy of 49.75%, whereas FF trained model achieved an accuracy of 50.95%.
